content: नम् €1 <ab>P.</ab> sometimes <ab>Ā.</ab> (नमति-ते, ननाम, अनंसीत्, नंस्यति, नत, {%<ab>caus.</ab>%} नमयति-ते or नामयति-ते, but with a preposition नमयति only; {%<ab>desid.</ab>%} निनंसति) also €9 <ab>P.</ab> (नम्नाति), €4. <ab>P.</ab> (नम्यति) .²1 To bow to, make obeisance to, salute (as a mark of respect) (with <ab>acc.</ab> or <ab>dat.</ab>); इयं नमति वः सर्वान् त्रिलोचनवधूरिति <ls>Ku. 6. 89</ls>; <ls>Bg. 11. 37</ls>; <ls>Bk. 9. 51</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">10. 31</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">12. 99</ls>; <ls>Śi. 4. 57</ls>. .²2 To submit or subject oneself, bow down; अशक्तः सन्धिमान् नमेत् <ls>Kām. 8. 55</ls>. .²3 To bend, sink; go down; अनंसीद्भूर्भरेणास्य <ls>Bk. 15. 25</ls>; नेमुः सर्वदिशः <ls>K. 55</ls>; उन्नमति नमति वर्षति … … मेघः <ls>Mk. 5. 26</ls>. .²4 To stoop, be inclined. .²5 To be bent or curved. .²6 To sound. .²7 To change a dental to a lingual letter. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To bend, make curved. .²2 To bend (as a bow); न नमयितुमधिज्यमस्मि शक्तः <ls>Ś. 2. 3</ls>. .²3 To cause to sink. .²4 To prevent, ward off. .²5 To subdue, make subordinate; स पुरस्कृतमध्यमक्रमो नमयामास नृपाननुद्धरन् <ls>R. 8. 9</ls>.
